'''Novastar Corporation''' was a company that specialized in the production of [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computers]], such as the [[L-17A Quikjump]], as well as upgrades.<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

Several rumors surrounded the company, including one belief that the Novastar was secretly developing a nav computer that could be used without an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], aiming to sell it a high price to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; in reality, the Empire would simply seize the whole corporation to get hands on the technology.<ref name="guide" /> 

Another rumor suggested that the corporation had secretly acquired debris of fallen [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]]s for the conducting of experiments.<ref name="guide" /> 

The company reached the height of its success during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
